verdict.rationale: Undermind documents an enterprise API and a hosted MCP server. Its MCP clients identify themselves via a Client ID Metadata Document, but that is client identification, not issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials. Nothing in the evidence describes creating API keys or tokens with restricted scopes or permissions for an agent, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
